answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Tending a horizon, watching a lantern, and naming a reef is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
